t: Xinxiang | Ancient City & Industrial Hub | Britannica
s: July 20, 1998 - It is a transportation centre located at the head of navigation of the Wei River, with access northeast to Tianjin, and at the southern end of a route from Hebei province that runs west to ultimately connect with southern Shanxi and Shaanxi provinces. Xinxiang was the capital of the short-lived Pingyuan province (1949–52); when that province was abolished, the city came back under the administration of Henan.
